title: A new Features page
summary: The Features page now shows one area at a time, with every major feature in detail and the smaller ones listed, plus search and a DM/player filter.
items: Pick an area from the tabs (Loot & money, Characters, Shops & trade, World, Maps, Encounters, Downtime, Play together, Library & tools, Platforms) instead of scrolling one long page.
Open any major feature to read what it does in detail, or expand them all.
Search finds a feature in any area, and the filter shows everything, player features or DM tools.
The list was checked against the app and now includes recent additions such as treasure pool claims, map place cards, the Here sheet and the journey planner.
